HOW IT WORKS

A workflow with boundaries.

Builder Garage documents responsibilities, evidence and handoffs. It is not autonomous orchestration.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Understand the system before changing it.

  2. 02

    Assess readiness

    Resolve material uncertainty deliberately.

  3. 03

    Implement

    Keep work scoped to the evidence.

  4. 04

    Inspect

    Independent review tests the real artifact.

  5. 05

    Ship

    Human authority remains with the maintainer.

Role boundaries

Agent #1 — Implementation

Owns scoped implementation, correction, validation and preparation for review.

Agent #2 — Independent review

Owns complete-artifact review and the approval or changes-required disposition.

The review contract

  1. Were the acceptance criteria met?
  2. Did the implementation introduce a regression?
  3. Does the implemented behavior work?

Current capabilities

The source-build CLI manages project configuration, local workflow records, installed skills and manuals, and read-only GitHub workflow status. The conceptual shop areas remain responsibilities rather than hosted runtime components.
